Baltimore’s listed rested bullpen arms to watch are Anthony Nunez, Yennier Cano, Andrew Kittredge, and left-hander Nick Raquet.
reminders: Right-handed hitters: prepare for fastballs first.
Lay off offspeed early; attack strikes you can drive.
